title: Construction of a Waste-to-Resource Knowledge Graph for Industrial Symbiosis Identification Using Large Language Models
core_idea: Develop an automated framework that uses large language models to transform unstructured research literature into a standardized waste-to-resource knowledge graph through modules for retrieval, information extraction, and fusion, enabling scalable coverage of waste-to-resource relationships to support industrial symbiosis identification.
tldr: An automated LLM-based pipeline to build a standardized, scalable waste-to-resource knowledge graph from research papers to support industrial symbiosis opportunity identification.
